entries.title: Run persistent Ops goals in parallel
entries.description: Create goals with a local folder or approved SSH project connection, their own Codex settings and one persistent conversation. Start, pause, resume or finish each goal independently. Different targets can work in parallel; overlapping canonical folders wait with a visible reason.

entries.title: Schedule follow-ups inside each goal
entries.description: Add multiple cron schedules with IANA time zones. A goal can manage only its own schedules through Codex tools, recording the reason for each change. Due instructions steer its active turn or continue the same idle conversation. Missed occurrences coalesce once; paused and finished goals never restart automatically.

entries.title: Inspect goal prompts, progress and recovery
entries.description: Preview common, goal and schedule instructions together, then inspect the exact submitted prompt, reason, originating schedules and outcome in history. Recover the original conversation after restart and restore backups with goals paused. Interactive approval requests appear as errors; Ops has no approval dialog.

entries.title: Keep background commands owned through pauses and errors
entries.description: Retain a goal's folder while its commands are running or unconfirmed, even after the model finishes or a new request fails. Pause and finish stop only that thread's terminals before releasing the target. Offline goals recover independently without blocking the application window, other goals or scheduled work.

entries.title: Refresh account usage automatically
entries.description: Collect account limits and supported detailed usage every 30 minutes in the background, including while the window is minimized. Choose a 1–1440 minute interval in Settings → Automatic checks and keep it after restarting. Overdue startup and resume refresh once; failures retain the last successful values and retry on the chosen interval.

entries.title: Stop agent tools before ending their runner
entries.description: Interrupt local and SSH agent execution gracefully before escalating termination, allowing Codex to stop its detached tool processes. Bounded termination fallback remains available when the runner does not exit.

entries.title: Update desktop certificate validation
entries.description: Update the desktop runtime to Electron 44.9.1, including its certificate validation fixes.
